I am an old man now, 86 years, but maize is our life here in Ntchisi. I received my coupon from the government programme, so I will use the NPK and urea on this small plot near the house — one bag of each, like they teach us. My grandchildren help me work the ridges, but my back is not what it was, so I must pay some young men from the village for the heavy digging and weeding. I will plant the hybrid seed that came with the coupon, and add some manure from the goats to stretch the fertilizer.
